function.name: calculate_sunrise_and_sunset
function.description: Calculate the sunrise and sunset time of a location for the given date. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location in city, state format.

date.description: The date for which the sunrise and sunset needs to be calculated in yyyy-mm-dd format.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live clock data. If you let me know the current UTC time or the date you’re interested in, I can tell you what the local time would be in New York based on its standard or daylight‑saving offset.
message.reasoning: User asks: "紐約現在是幾點？" (What time is it now in New York?). We need to provide current time. But we don't have real-time data. We can approximate using UTC offset? But we can't guarantee DST. We could say "I don't have real-time capability." But maybe we can use an external API? Not allowed. So we should respond that I cannot provide real-time info. But we can give approximate based on known timezone: New York is UTC-5 or -4 depending on DST. But we don't know current date. We can ask user for date/time? Or we can say "I don't have real-time capability." According to policy, we should not fabricate. So we should say we cannot provide real-time.
